court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Ashok Wasudeorao Marchettiwar vs Arun Wasudeorao Marchettiwar

parties.respondent_defendant: Arun s/o Wasudeorao Marchettiwar (Since Deceased) and others (Respondents)

facts_of_case: The dispute is between two real brothers over a plot of land purchased jointly. The respondent-plaintiff claims the suit property was partitioned in 1983, but the defendant-appellant disputes this. The trial court passed a decree for possession in favor of the plaintiff.

legal_principles.principle: The preponderance of probabilities is in favour of the plaintiff to hold that the suit plot was purchased and the construction was made jointly by all the three brothers.
legal_principles.held: The Court holds that the preponderance of probabilities is in favour of the plaintiff to hold that the suit plot was purchased and the construction was made jointly by all the three brothers.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party claiming a joint family property to prove that it is indeed a joint family property.
legal_principles.held: None mentioned in this judgment, but impliedly stated as the court's approach.

outcome.final_order: The original decree for possession was maintained by dismissing the appeal.
